name: 🍀Hard Time
desc:
🚨 HARD TIME RETURNS! 🚨 — Hard Time is BACK! Thank you for your patience, and welcome back!

Welcome to Hard Time, make money and fight to survive in these hard streets.

💵 Rob, be a hitman, or work a job for Cash.
🔫 Use Cash to buy Guns, Cars, and Properties.
👮 Switch to the other side and catch criminals.

🗡️ All Melee Weapons use Stamina to attack. Fight smart.
👥 You can only join groups that you are a member of.
❌ Private servers do not save stats.
📣 Leaving the game in Combat will cause you to lose your inventory items and bounty.

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX & PlayStation

[PC/XBOX/PS5 CONTROLS] (All Controls available in game!)
Drop Item [X/DPad Left]
Block [F/Button Y/Button Triangle]
Stomp/Finish [E/PadDown]
Carry [G/PadUp]
Crouch [C/Button B/Button Circle]
Run [Left Shift/Left Thumbstick]
Reload [R/Button X/Button Square]
Camera Lock [Left Control/LT]
